title: FullDARK
description: This resource pack does not do fullbright but instead does fullDARK
body:
This resource pack (FullDARK) makes everything **DARK** and not **BRIGHT** as opposed to those _really_ convenient fullbright packs that makes everything bright and might not be allowed on servers.
It changes the shaders file for the lightmap which changes how the game is rendered and it makes a tweak that makes the brightness `0.0` which just makes it pure black but it might not be black sometimes
**NOTE: MAKE SURE YOU KNOW HOW TO NAVIGATE INTO RESOURCE PACKS IN SETTINGS BECAUSE THIS ALSO SOMEHOW MAKES THE TEXT INVISIBLE ON THE BUTTONS IN THE MENU!** **Who turned off the lights?** ## UPDATE AS OF 26.1 It no longer hides text
